messages.otherItems: Would you like to know the value of other items?

options.label: What gives a project value?
options.description: Opustown calculates various metrics such as the F-Index, P-Index, V-Index, and A-Index. The final project value refers to the C-Index. The Absolute Indexes provided by Opustown are for reference only and do not represent market prices.

options.label: Tell me about the creator
options.description: The Captain's name is {captainName}, and this project was launched on {launchDate}. The current members consist of {leadGroupMembers} Lead Group members, {creditMembers} Credit Members, and {heartMembers} Heart Members. {captainName} has launched {projectsLaunched} projects and is participating in {projectsAsContributor} projects as a contributor.

options.label: What should I check first?
options.description: To participate in a creative project, first check the project's Goal, Concept, and Tone & Mood. Then, consider contributing by proposing stories or building up images. If you have received credits in a collaborative project, check your share. You can trust the fair distribution of copyrights by Opustown, which aims for "Allocative Web 3.0." Depending on the commercialization, the joint copyright for the entire project differs from the joint copyright for each section.

indices.name: Participation
indices.advice: Invite visitors to contribute and keep participants involved with regular updates.
